description: Preview an image in ascii, palette-map, scale, or nine-slice mode. Read-only except scale and nine-slice, which may write a PNG only to the explicit output path; never invents filenames.

inputPath.description: Raster image or .mcpx path to preview; omitted in contact-sheet mode.

inputPaths.description: contact-sheet only: input image paths in sheet order.

mcmetaPath.description: Explicit .mcmeta path used by nine-slice mode.

mode.description: Preview mode: ascii, palette-map, scale, nine-slice, or contact-sheet.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

pairMode.description: contact-sheet only: pair two inputs per cell.

name: preview_asset
